verdict.rationale: Pika documents an agent-readable developer platform: a downloadable OpenAPI 3.1 spec, llms.txt, and per-operation machine-readable pages for /v1/media generation paths. It also offers never-charged quote, balance and spend reads, which cover submitting a prompt and reporting cost from docs alone. However, the pack never documents job-status polling or a webhook for watching the job, nor how to fetch the finished asset, so the middle of the loop is only implied. Missing for 10: documented job-status/polling endpoint, documented asset retrieval/download, a worked end-to-end example, independent hands-on corroboration of the full loop.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, an agent can run the full video loop from docs alone: submit the prompt, watch the job, fetch the asset, and report the cost
